claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says artificial portals send a wormhole vortex rather than the apparatus; travelers need a portal at their destination to return.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says ships and portals reach destinations by matching frequencies; ships use mapped locations and engines tuned to destination frequencies.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She describes natural portals as dependent on many planetary and nearby-astral conditions, potentially predictable but unstable and unreliable.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says Taygetan ships create wormholes at will and use quantum holographic computers with particle nano-accelerators instead of transistor cores.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
